principles.label: Our approach
principles.heading: How we build.
principles.note: Four principles we come back to.

items.title: Build with purpose.
items.text: Find a real need before writing the first line. Every product should earn its place in someone’s day.

items.title: Keep it simple.
items.text: Make the useful things easy to find. Remove the extra steps. Leave people with less to think about.

items.title: Experiment. Then iterate.
items.text: Give ideas a chance, even the unexpected ones. Learn from what works, listen to what doesn’t, and keep improving.

items.title: Make things that matter.
items.text: Care about the small decisions. Build for the people who will use it, and for the days after the first impression.
